anya: Heads-up from onboarding: telltell-v2 fp16 -> int8 (per-tensor symmetric) finished on our 10k multilang holdout. Seeing a notable drop on short queries.
mike: Numbers?
anya: run: onboard-2026-03-21-tellv2. Holdout=wiki-mini-10k. Metrics fp16 -> int8: recall@1 0.72 -> 0.64, recall@5 0.92 -> 0.86, median cosine shift -0.028, cluster_purity (k=50) 0.68 -> 0.60. Short queries (<=8 tokens) recall@1 drop 11pts.
sara: That short-query delta is alarming. Did you apply L2 norm after quantization?
anya: We normalized before indexing but not forced after quant. Index: faiss IVFPQ 8192,PQ64, metric=inner_product (we normalize beforehand so IP==cosine). Embed batch=256, quant cal set from 100k calibration samples (uniform).
mike: Could be PQ interaction with int8 scale. Try do no-pq (flat) on a subset and re-eval. Also run an L2-postnorm ablation and a top-128 float re-rank baseline.
sara: Also try increasing calibrator short-query proportion to 40% and re-run calibration. Sometimes quant maps short heads poorly.
anya: Scheduling ablations: (1) L2 post-quant + flat 10k sample eval; (2) top-128 float re-rank of int8 vectors; (3) symmetric->asymmetric per-channel quick pass. Kicked jobs off. ETA ~35m.
embed-bot: auto-report: onboard-2026-03-21-tellv2 initial_drop=8pts@1; short_tail_drop=11pts@1; affected_segments=short_en,lang:es,pt; artifacts=/runs/onboard-2026-03-21-tellv2.
anya: Quick repro command for local: ```python3 -m evals.run --model telltell-v2-int8 --holdout wiki-mini-10k --index faiss://ivf8192_pq64 --metrics recall@1,recall@5,cluster_purity --batch 256 --normalize pre```
mike: When ablations finish, please attach a UMAP colored by query-length and a nearest-neighbor overlap table (top10 overlap between fp16 and int8). That will show neighborhood preservation.
sara: Also add a synthetic short-query perturbation set (5k paraphrases) to stress test. If that reproduces, it's a calibration + quant mapping issue.
anya: Added synthetic set. FYI I saw slightly different behavior when indexing with cosine metric vs IP. Might be worth comparing faiss binary vs float index (just for sanity).
mike: Good. If per-tensor symmetric helps, we should bake that into the quick-calib path for small models. If not, consider increasing quant buckets or moving to int6-perchannel for projection layers.
devops-bot: job onboard-2026-03-21-tellv2-ablation-1 queued on gpu-pool-embed-2. ETA 22m.
embed-bot: will ping thread with final numbers + artifacts links.
anya: Attached first UMAP preview to run artifacts: short-query points are denser in fp16 clusters and more scattered in int8; will post ablation numbers when available. Thanks all :thumbsup:
